supermarkets.title: Supermarkets
supermarkets.text: There are 5 stores less than 10 minutes walking distance from the building, located on Calle 70.

restaurants.title: Restaurants
restaurants.atrium: Burgers, hot dogs, pizza, desgranados (loaded corn bowls), desserts

more: Pharmacies, car rentals, and other businesses are also on Calle 70.

atms.title: ATMs
atms.text: At the airport, 5 minutes walking from the building, there are ATMs from several banks. Other ATMs are also located on Calle 70.

crespo.title: Crespo beaches
crespo.text: Downstairs from the building, with direct access.
crespo.swim: Swimming is prohibited, but you can stay and walk on the beach.
crespo.park: The Crespo Lineal Park is downstairs from the building, with a bike path.

marbella.title: Marbella beaches
marbella.text: The closest beaches where swimming is allowed.
